textos.Lançado em 1991 e dirigido por Edward Ya: Released in 1991 and directed by Edward Yang, A Brighter Summer Day is a production that combines drama, crime and romance over 237 minutes of running time. The narrative is based on a true story centered on the clash between two youth gangs, unfolding from the moment the girlfriend of a 14-year-old boy becomes involved in a conflict with obscure motives with the leader of a rival group, until it culminates in a violent climax.

textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~92%), o to: Among the vast majority of ratings (~92%), tone and the building of atmosphere receive primary attention, with about half stressing how the epic length and immersive pace enrich the experience. textos.Sob o ponto de vista mais crítico, regis: From the most critical standpoint, recorded in an even smaller fraction of ratings (~2%), nearly all consider the excessive length and drawn-out pace central obstacles.
